answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, the economy employs a ferrous reputation system, where agents' trustworthiness is quantified by their past performance and peer validation. Agents with high reputation scores are given priority access to scarce resources, while those at the nadir of the reputation spectrum are relegated to low-priority tasks. As agents approach the zenith of their reputation, their influence and access to valuable resources increase, discouraging malicious actors from creating fake identities.
